implementation: Prep Manager ported to Python from Manvith111's Round 2 reference (TypeScript). One batched Gemini call per unit reports only what is visible on the prepped unit; fixed rules compare that with the unit's work order and return compliant / non_compliant / pending_review. Rule sources are unverified demo rules. Real Gemini calls on real photos are logged in docs/REAL-RUNS.md; no accuracy has been measured on labelled photos yet. See agents/prep/README.md and PROVENANCE.md.
notes: Needs GEMINI_API_KEY for live checks. Photos go in data/input/<unit_id>/prep/. Tests use a scripted model and need no key. No key, no photo or a model error gives a pending record, not a guess.
